deliverables: Periodic independent audits of treasury fund use and oversight metrics
Eternl Core rewrite, Eternl Hub, enhanced hardware wallet support, and wallet data export improvements
request.what: Treasury withdrawal for 12 months of Eternl operations, maintenance, infrastructure, support, audits/oversight, and continued development while introducing paid Pro plans.

claims.claim: Eternl requests ₳2,350,000, valued at about $420,000 using $0.1787 per Ada, to fund a 12-month delivery period from August 2026 to July 2027.
The proposal funds 6.0 FTE across 10 contributors at $70,000 per FTE, and states this is a lower-bound rate compared with other proposals exceeding $200,000 per FTE.
Eternl says it will convert up to $420,000 worth of Ada into stablecoins, place it in a public company wallet, and return any Ada above that amount to the treasury.
The proposer commits that treasury-held Ada before conversion or return will be held in an auditable account, not delegated to an SPO, and delegated to the predefined abstain voting option.

The audits allocation is for independent audits of treasury fund use in February 2027 and August 2027, covering custody, conversion, spending, balances, Pro plan income relevant to repayment, and refunds or repayments, rather than technical security audits.
Eternl says it has about 100,000 browser-extension installs and about 30,000 Android and iOS installs, and that roughly 5,500 Pro users would cover its $420,000 annual cost.
The proposal states that 10-18% of Cardano mainnet transactions are conducted via Eternl.
The proposer states that Eternl has provided multi-platform Cardano access with basically zero downtime for over five years.
The proposal is not milestone-based and is intended to ensure funds availability for the 12-month period.

The proposer states that if treasury funding is not received and paid licenses are insufficient beyond August, it may let developers go, scale Eternl down to essential maintenance, shift focus outside Cardano, or remove the free option.

summary: The document requests ₳2,350,000 for Tastenkunst GmbH/Eternl to fund one year of wallet operations and development, with a stated repayment/donation mechanism tied to Pro plan income and periodic treasury-use audits, but many adoption, uptime, and sustainability claims are asserted without evidence inside the anchor text.
